title: File:Kasanka National Park Bat feast.jpg
desc: In November-December, a very small bat forest area in Kasanka National Park is crowded with bats from all over Africa. It is one of the most impressive natural 'feasts' I have ever witnessed.

desc: This panorama is showing Lake Wasa in Kasanka National Park. An immensely beautiful and peaceful place to stay in Northern Zambia.

title: File:Kasanka National Park Early burning.jpg
desc: Fire management is an essential part of Zambia's woodlands. Here the early burning team of Kasanka NP is carrying out fire management in the cold dry season to avoid intense destructive fires going through the park later on in the warmer dry season.
